cases.d: Verify the Secretary stores a recording with consent, purpose and retention.
steps: As the Secretary, send POST /api/meetings/<id>/recordings as multipart/form-data with fields consentConfirmed=true, consentPurpose="Lập biên bản phiên họp", durationMs=65000 and file phien-hop.wav (audio/wav).
As the Member, GET /api/meetings/<id>/recordings.
Repeat for an InProgress and an Ended meeting.
exp: HTTP 201 Created with code "MSG290" ("Đã lưu bản ghi.").
The Member's list has one item phien-hop.wav with the purpose, retention date and duration; canUpload is false for the Member.
One audio file is added to storage.
pre: An InProgress (or Ended) meeting with Secretary and Member.
File storage is configured.

cases.d: Verify the upload form carries only a file recorded elsewhere and codec parameters are accepted.
steps: As the Secretary, POST /api/meetings/<id>/recordings with consentConfirmed=true, a valid file and source=BrowserCapture.
POST again with file ghi-ngoai.webm of type audio/webm;codecs=opus and no durationMs.
GET /api/meetings/<id>/recordings.
exp: The form claiming a browser capture returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG291" ("Thông tin bản ghi không hợp lệ."): only the room mic records in the browser.
The upload returns HTTP 201 with code "MSG290".
The item has source "Upload", contentType "audio/webm", durationMs 0 and takes null.
pre: An InProgress in-person meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify a refused upload leaves no audio behind.
steps: As the Secretary, POST a recording without consentConfirmed.
POST with source=Telepathy.
POST with durationMs=-5.
POST with no file, with a non-audio file, and as a non-multipart body.
exp: Each request returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG291"; the first names consentConfirmed.
No audio file is added to storage.
pre: An InProgress meeting and its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify nothing can be recorded before the meeting starts.
steps: For a Draft, Approved and Published meeting, as the Secretary POST a valid recording, then GET the recordings list.
exp: Each upload returns HTTP 409 with code "MSG294" ("Chỉ lưu bản ghi khi cuộc họp đang diễn ra hoặc đã kết thúc.").
canUpload is false.
pre: One meeting per status with a Secretary.

cases.d: Verify only the Secretary manages recordings and only the roster can listen.
steps: As the Chair and the Member, POST a recording, DELETE /api/recordings/<id> and GET /api/recordings/<id>/playback.
As an outsider, GET the playback.
exp: Upload and delete return HTTP 403 with code "MSG295" (only the meeting Secretary may manage recordings).
Playback returns HTTP 200 for the Chair and the Member.
The outsider gets HTTP 404; storage is unchanged.
pre: An InProgress meeting with one stored recording.

cases.d: Verify the playback URL streams with ranges and cannot be forged or used after it expires.
steps: As the Member, GET /api/recordings/<id>/playback and copy url.
Without authentication, GET that url, then with header Range: bytes=0-99.
Change one character of the signature and GET it; wait until it expires and GET it again.
exp: url starts with /api/recordings/<id>/audio?expires=.
The full request returns HTTP 200 audio/wav; the range request returns HTTP 206 with 100 bytes.
The forged and the expired URLs are refused (HTTP 404 or 403).
pre: An InProgress meeting with one stored recording.

cases.d: Verify erasing removes the audio and its transcript but keeps the evidence row.
steps: As the Member, get a playback URL.
As the Secretary, DELETE /api/recordings/<id>; repeat the DELETE.
Open the old playback URL and the transcript.
exp: Both deletes return HTTP 200 with code "MSG296".
The audio file and the transcript text ("Kính thưa các đồng chí.") are gone.
The recording row stays with status Deleted, who deleted it and when.
The old playback URL no longer plays.
pre: A recording with a completed transcript.

cases.d: Verify the retention sweep erases only recordings past their retention date.
steps: Store one recording, move the server clock 100 days ahead and store another, then move 81 more days ahead.
Run the retention sweep (the background job, or restart the backend).
exp: The first recording is Deleted.
The second recording is still Stored.
pre: An InProgress meeting; retention is 180 days.

cases.d: Verify database outages answer with their own codes and leave no stray file.
steps: Stop PostgreSQL and GET the recordings list.
Make saving fail and POST a recording, then DELETE a recording.
exp: The read returns HTTP 500 with code "MSG297" ("Không tải được danh sách bản ghi.").
Upload and delete return HTTP 503 with code "MSG298".
The uploaded file is removed again; storage is unchanged.
pre: An InProgress meeting with one recording.

cases.d: Verify an upload queues speech-to-text and the result keeps speakers and timestamps.
steps: As the Secretary, upload a recording.
As the Member, GET the list and GET /api/recordings/<id>/transcript.
Wait for the speech worker, then GET the transcript again.
exp: Right after upload transcriptStatus is "Pending", there are no segments and canEdit is false.
After processing the status is Completed with segments that have speaker labels and start and end times.
pre: An InProgress meeting; the speech-to-text worker is running.

cases.d: Verify a failed transcript is explained and only the Secretary can run it again.
steps: Stop the speech worker and upload a recording.
As the Secretary, GET the transcript.
As the Member, POST /api/recordings/<id>/transcribe; as the Secretary, POST it.
exp: The status is "Failed" with errorMessage "Không kết nối được máy chủ nhận dạng giọng nói.".
The Member is refused (HTTP 403); the Secretary's request queues it again (HTTP 200) and the status returns to Pending.
pre: An InProgress meeting with Secretary and Member.

cases.d: Verify a recording without a transcript can be sent to speech-to-text.
steps: Delete the transcript row of a stored recording (test data).
As the Secretary, GET the transcript, then POST /api/recordings/<id>/transcribe.
exp: The status is "None" and canEdit is true.
Transcribe returns HTTP 200 and a new Pending transcript is created.
pre: An InProgress meeting with a stored recording.

cases.d: Verify a missing audio file fails that transcript instead of blocking the queue.
steps: Upload a recording, then delete its audio file from storage.
Let the speech worker run; GET the transcript.
exp: The transcript is "Failed" with errorMessage "Tệp âm thanh không còn trên máy chủ.".
Other recordings in the queue are still processed.
pre: An InProgress meeting; the speech worker is running.

cases.d: Verify the Secretary corrects a transcript segment and the correction is attributed.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token of the meeting Secretary>
req.body: { "text": " Tôi đề nghị bổ sung kinh phí đào tạo. " }

exp: HTTP 200 with code "MSG302" ("Đã lưu đoạn gỡ băng.").
The text is saved trimmed with the Secretary as editor and the edit time.
An empty text or more than 8000 characters returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG303".
pre: A recording with a completed transcript.

cases.d: Verify a recording erased while the worker runs gets no transcript back.
steps: Upload a recording and, while the speech worker is processing it, DELETE the recording as the Secretary.
exp: The delete returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG296".
When the worker finishes, no transcript is stored; the recording stays Deleted.
pre: An InProgress meeting; the speech worker is running.

cases.d: Verify interrupted runs are queued again and outages have their codes.
steps: Set a transcript to Processing and restart the backend.
As the Secretary, GET the transcript.
Stop PostgreSQL and GET the transcript again.
exp: After restart the transcript is back to "Pending".
With the database down the read returns HTTP 500 with code "MSG299" ("Không tải được bản gỡ băng.").
pre: A recording whose transcript was being processed.

cases.d: Verify a sentence from my microphone is transcribed and named after me once.
steps: As the Member, send PUT /api/meetings/<id>/speech-clips/<new UUID>?startedAt=<3 seconds ago, ISO>&durationMs=2400 with Content-Type: audio/wav and the recorded sentence.
Send the same request again with the same clientId.
exp: HTTP 200 with code "MSG318".
clip.speakerId is the Member and clip.text is "Tôi đồng ý với dự thảo. Đề nghị biểu quyết.".
The repeat returns the saved sentence without transcribing again.
The sentence's audio is stored (audio/wav) and its line has hasAudio true; the list reports retentionDays 180.
pre: An InProgress Online or Hybrid meeting (captured per microphone); the speech worker is running.

cases.d: Verify silence stores nothing.
steps: As the Member, send a speech clip that contains only silence.
GET /api/meetings/<id>/speech-clips.
exp: HTTP 204 No Content.
The list is empty.
No audio file is stored.
pre: An InProgress Online or Hybrid meeting (captured per microphone); the speech worker is running.

cases.d: Verify sentences are accepted only from people of a running meeting joined from afar.
steps: As the Member, send a sentence to an InProgress in-person meeting (recorded by the room mic) and GET its speech-clips.
Send a sentence to a Published meeting that has not started.
As an outsider, send a sentence to a running Online meeting.
As the organizer, who is not on the roster, GET /api/meetings/<id>/speech-clips.
exp: In-person and not started: HTTP 409 with code "MSG320" ("Cuộc họp trực tiếp không ghi theo micro từng người, hoặc cuộc họp không còn đang diễn ra."); canCapture is false for the in-person meeting.
Outsider: HTTP 404.
Organizer: HTTP 404; no one's words are theirs to read.
pre: Meetings as described with the Member on their roster.

cases.d: Verify a malformed or oversized sentence is refused before the speech worker hears it.
steps: As the Member, send clips with: Content-Type text/plain; startedAt="hôm qua"; durationMs=0; more than 60 seconds of audio.
exp: Each request returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG319".
The speech worker is not called.
pre: An InProgress Online or Hybrid meeting (captured per microphone).

cases.d: Verify a speech worker outage keeps nothing so the browser sends the sentence again.
steps: Stop the speech worker.
As the Member, send a clip; GET the clip list.
exp: HTTP 503 with code "MSG312" ("Máy chủ nhận dạng giọng nói chưa sẵn sàng ...").
The list is empty.
pre: An InProgress Online or Hybrid meeting (captured per microphone).

cases.d: Verify the Secretary corrects a sentence and nobody else can.
steps: As the Member, PUT /api/speech-clips/<id>/text with { "text": "Sửa" }.
As the Secretary, send { "text": " " }, then { "text": "Tôi đồng ý." }.
exp: The Member gets HTTP 403 with code "MSG295".
An empty text returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG303".
The correction returns HTTP 200 and is saved with the Secretary as editor.
pre: A stored sentence spoken by the Member.

cases.d: Verify the speaker or the Secretary can take a sentence back.
steps: As the Chair, DELETE the Member's sentence.
As the Member, DELETE their own sentence.
As the Secretary, DELETE another of the Member's sentences.
exp: The Chair gets HTTP 403 with code "MSG323" ("Chỉ người nói hoặc Thư ký được xoá câu này.").
The Member and the Secretary get HTTP 200 with code "MSG322" ("Đã xoá câu nói.").
pre: Two stored sentences spoken by the Member.

cases.d: Verify a meeting joined from afar is captured per microphone (Online, Hybrid).
steps: As the Member of an InProgress Online meeting, GET /api/meetings/<id>/speech-clips.
Send a sentence with PUT /api/meetings/<id>/speech-clips/<new UUID>.
Repeat for a Hybrid meeting.
exp: canCapture is true.
The sentence returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG318" ("Đã ghi câu nói.").
The capture mode follows the meeting's Hình thức; there is no capture-mode setting to change.
pre: InProgress Online and Hybrid meetings with the Member on their roster; the speech worker is running.

cases.d: Verify a database outage on reading sentences says so.
exp: HTTP 500 with code "MSG299".
pre: thanhvien is on the roster of an InProgress meeting.
The PostgreSQL container is stopped after sign-in.

cases.d: Verify Voice ID consent is explicit, versioned and given once.
steps: As the Member, GET /api/me/voice.
POST /api/me/voice/consent with an old notice version.
POST it with the current noticeVersion; POST it again.
exp: Before consent, consent is null and the response shows noticeVersion, maxSamples and the data controller.
An old notice version is refused.
The current version records consent once; repeating does not create a second consent.
pre: The Member has never consented to Voice ID.

cases.d: Verify voice samples need consent, pass the worker checks and are stored only encrypted.
steps: As the Chair without consent, POST /api/me/voice/samples with a recording.
Give consent, then upload a sample with two people speaking.
Upload a good sample; inspect the voice_samples table.
exp: Without consent: HTTP 409 with code "MSG308" ("Cần đồng ý nhận diện giọng nói trước khi ghi giọng mẫu.").
Two speakers: HTTP 422 with code "MSG309" and reason "multiple_speakers" (message mentions more than one person).
The good sample is stored; the embedding column holds only encrypted bytes.
pre: The speech worker is running.

cases.d: Verify a person deletes only their own voice samples.
steps: As the Chair, DELETE /api/me/voice/samples/<Member's sample id>.
As the Member, DELETE the same sample.
exp: The Chair gets HTTP 404.
The Member gets HTTP 200 with code "MSG311" ("Đã xoá giọng mẫu.") and the sample is gone.
pre: The Member consented and has one voice sample.

cases.d: Verify voices are suggested only as consenting people of the meeting and named only by the Secretary.
steps: Enrol the Secretary, the Member and an outsider (all consenting).
Upload and transcribe a recording with three voices that match them.
As the Secretary, GET the transcript; as the Member, PUT /api/recordings/<id>/speakers/SPEAKER_00 with { "userId": "<id>" }; as the Secretary, PUT it.
exp: Suggestions are offered only for the Secretary and the Member, never the outsider.
The Member's naming is refused.
The Secretary's naming returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG316" ("Đã gán người nói.").
pre: An InProgress meeting; the speech worker is running.

cases.d: Verify withdrawing consent erases samples and suggestions but keeps what the Secretary decided.
steps: Enrol the Secretary and the Member; transcribe a recording; the Secretary names SPEAKER_01 as the Member.
As the Member, DELETE /api/me/voice/consent.
GET /api/me/voice and the transcript.
exp: The withdrawal succeeds and the Member's samples are erased.
Automatic suggestions for the Member disappear.
The Secretary's naming of SPEAKER_01 stays.
pre: An InProgress meeting; the speech worker is running.

cases.d: Verify Voice ID outages answer with their own codes.
steps: Make saving fail and give consent.
Stop PostgreSQL and GET /api/me/voice.
exp: Consent returns HTTP 503 with code "MSG315" ("Không lưu được thay đổi. Vui lòng thử lại.").
Reading returns HTTP 500 with code "MSG314" ("Không tải được thông tin giọng nói.").
pre: Signed in as thanhvien@trustcabinet.local.

cases.d: Verify an online meeting has no room recording (InProgress, Ended).
steps: As the Secretary of an Online meeting, POST /api/meetings/<id>/recordings with a valid form.
GET /api/meetings/<id>/recordings.
Repeat for an in-person meeting in the same status.
exp: Online: HTTP 409 with code "MSG358" ("Cuộc họp trực tuyến ghi theo micro từng người, không có bản ghi phòng."); canUpload is false and no file is stored.
In-person: the upload returns HTTP 201 with code "MSG290".
pre: InProgress and Ended meetings, Online and in-person, each with its Secretary.
File storage is configured.

cases.d: Verify the first take streams in parts and becomes the meeting's room recording.
steps: As the Member and the Secretary, GET /api/meetings/<id>/recordings and read canRecord.
As the Secretary, POST /api/meetings/<id>/recordings/takes with body { "consentConfirmed": true, "consentPurpose": "Lập biên bản phiên họp" }.
As the Member, GET the list and GET /api/recordings/<take>/playback.

As the Secretary, PUT /api/recordings/<take>/parts/1 with the first full part, send part 1 again, then PUT /api/recordings/<take>/parts/2?final=true with the shorter last part. Each part is application/octet-stream of exactly partSize bytes; part 1 starts with a WAV header for 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM.
POST /api/recordings/<take>/complete, then call it again.
GET the list as the Member.
exp: canRecord is true for the Secretary and false for the Member.
The take returns HTTP 201 with recordingId and partSize.
While recording, everyone sees one item with status "Pending", created by the Secretary; only the Secretary may close it; playback returns HTTP 404.
Each part, including the repeated part 1, returns HTTP 204.
Both completions return HTTP 200 with code "MSG363" ("Đã lưu lượt ghi."), the same recordingId and appended false.
The item is "Available", source "BrowserCapture", transcriptStatus "Pending", with the purpose, the duration of the PCM and one take at offset 0; the stored WAV header carries the final length.
The audit log records the take started and saved by the Secretary.
pre: An InProgress in-person meeting with Secretary and Member.
File storage is configured.

cases.d: Verify a later take is appended to the room recording and the whole is transcribed again.
steps: As the Secretary, record and complete a first take; let the speech worker finish.
Ten minutes later, POST /api/meetings/<id>/recordings/takes with consentConfirmed=false, stream a second take and complete it.
GET the list, then let the worker run and GET /api/recordings/<room>/transcript.
exp: The second take needs no new consent; completing returns code "MSG363" with the room recording's id and appended true.
There is still one item; it lists two takes, the second at the end of the first, with its own duration and start time; transcriptStatus is "Pending".
The stored file is the first take followed by the second without its header; the whole file is transcribed and the transcript ends "Completed".
No separate recording is left for the second take.
pre: An InProgress in-person meeting; signed in as its Secretary; speech worker running.

cases.d: Verify a take appended while the room recording is being transcribed makes that run start over.
steps: As the Secretary, record and complete a take.
While the speech worker transcribes it, record and complete a second take.
GET /api/recordings/<room>/transcript, then let the worker run again.
exp: The result of the shorter file is discarded: the transcript is "Pending" with no segments.
The next run transcribes the whole room recording.
pre: An InProgress in-person meeting; signed in as its Secretary; speech worker running.

cases.d: Verify the room mic switches on only for the Secretary of a running in-person meeting.
steps: As the Member, then as an outsider, POST /api/meetings/<id>/recordings/takes.
As the Secretary, POST with consentConfirmed=false for the first take.
As the Secretary of an Online meeting, and of an Ended in-person meeting, POST a take.
As the Secretary, open a take, then POST another one.
DELETE /api/recordings/<open take>.
exp: Member: HTTP 403 with code "MSG295" ("Chỉ Thư ký cuộc họp được quản lý bản ghi."). Outsider: HTTP 404.
No consent before the first take: HTTP 400 with code "MSG291" and an error on consentConfirmed.
Online: HTTP 409 "MSG358". Ended: HTTP 409 "MSG359" ("Chỉ bật mic phòng khi cuộc họp đang diễn ra.").
A second open take: HTTP 409 "MSG360" ("Mic phòng đang ghi ở một máy khác.").
Deleting the open take: HTTP 409 "MSG364" ("Mic phòng đang ghi lượt này. Tắt mic để lưu rồi mới xoá được."); the file stays.
pre: An InProgress in-person meeting with Secretary, Member and an outsider; an Online and an Ended meeting.

cases.d: Verify parts come in order, at their size, from the take's maker, until it is saved.
steps: As the Secretary, open a take.
PUT part 1 as plain noise with no WAV header; as a WAV at 44.1 kHz; two bytes short of partSize; PUT part 0; PUT part 2 before part 1.
As the Chair, PUT part 1 and POST /api/recordings/<take>/complete.
As the Secretary, PUT part 1, PUT part 2?final=true with 10 bytes, then PUT part 3.
Complete the take, then PUT part 2 again.
exp: Every malformed or out-of-order part returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG361" ("Phần âm thanh gửi lên không hợp lệ.").
Chair: the part returns HTTP 404; completing returns HTTP 403 "MSG295".
Valid parts return HTTP 204; a part after the short last part returns HTTP 400 "MSG361".
After the take is saved, a part returns HTTP 409 "MSG362" ("Lượt ghi này đã được lưu, không thêm tiếng vào được nữa.").
pre: An InProgress in-person meeting with its Secretary and Chair.

cases.d: Verify a take cannot grow past the recording limit.
steps: As the Secretary, open a take.
PUT parts one after another until their total reaches Recordings:MaxUploadMegabytes.
PUT one more part.
exp: Parts within the limit return HTTP 204.
The part past the limit returns HTTP 413 with code "MSG293" ("Bản ghi vượt quá 300 MB." with the configured size).
pre: An InProgress in-person meeting; a small Recordings:MaxUploadMegabytes on the test server.

cases.d: Verify a take the mic heard nothing in is dropped.
steps: As the Secretary, open a take and complete it without sending any part.
GET the list.
Open a new take.
exp: HTTP 200 with code "MSG365" ("Mic chưa thu được tiếng nào nên lượt này không được lưu.") and recordingId null.
The list is empty and no file is stored.
The mic switches on again normally (HTTP 201).
pre: An InProgress in-person meeting; signed in as its Secretary.

cases.d: Verify a take left open is saved by the server once no part has come for hours.
steps: As the Secretary, open a take and send part 1, then close the browser.
Run the idle-take sweep at once, and again after 13 hours without parts.
GET the list.
exp: The first sweep saves nothing.
After 13 hours the take is saved: the item is "Available".
The audit log records the take saved with no actor (the server).
pre: An InProgress in-person meeting; the server clock can be advanced.

cases.d: Verify a take is cut out of the room recording and its lines out of the transcript, keeping the rest.
steps: As the Secretary, record three takes and let the transcript finish with one line in each take.
Correct the third line and name SPEAKER_00 as the Chair.
As the Member, DELETE /api/recordings/<room>/takes/2. As the Secretary, DELETE take 4, then take 2.
GET the list and the transcript.
DELETE take 2 again, then take 1.
exp: Member: HTTP 403 "MSG295". Take 4: HTTP 404.
Deleting take 2: HTTP 200 with code "MSG366" ("Đã xoá lượt ghi.").
The audio is takes 1 and 3 back to back; the duration and the take offsets shrink by the removed take.
The transcript is "Completed" with the first line and the corrected third line moved up; the name given to SPEAKER_00 stays and the voice heard only in take 2 is gone.
With one take left, deleting it returns HTTP 409 "MSG367" ("Bản ghi chỉ còn một lượt ghi. Xoá cả bản ghi nếu muốn bỏ lượt này.").
pre: An InProgress in-person meeting with Secretary, Chair and Member; speech worker running.

cases.d: Verify the Chair or a Secretary saves the original file and a playback link cannot be turned into one.
steps: As the Member, GET the list (canDownload) and GET /api/recordings/<id>/download.
As the Chair, GET the list and GET /api/recordings/<id>/download; open the returned url without signing in.
As the Member, GET /api/recordings/<id>/playback; open its url with &download=1 appended, then without it.
exp: Member: canDownload is false; download returns HTTP 403 with code "MSG355" ("Chỉ Chủ tọa hoặc Thư ký được tải bản ghi và bản gỡ băng về.").
Chair: canDownload is true; the url ends with &download=1 and returns the original file as an attachment.
The playback url with &download=1 returns HTTP 404; without it, HTTP 200.
The audit log records one recording.downloaded.
pre: An Internal meeting with a stored, transcribed recording; Chair and Member on the roster.

cases.d: Verify a finished transcript is saved as text with the names the Secretary gave.
steps: As the Secretary, name SPEAKER_00 as the Chair and GET the transcript (canExport).
GET /api/recordings/<id>/transcript.txt.
As the Member, GET the transcript and transcript.txt.
As the Secretary, POST /api/recordings/<id>/transcribe, then GET transcript.txt.
exp: canExport is true; the file is text/plain named ban-go-bang-…, starting with the meeting title and "Bản gỡ băng — bản ghi phien-hop.wav".
Each line is "[hh:mm:ss] <name>: <text>", using the assigned name, or "Người nói N".
Member: canExport is false; the file returns HTTP 403 "MSG355".
Re-queueing returns HTTP 202 "MSG300"; while not finished the file returns HTTP 409 "MSG357" ("Bản gỡ băng chưa xong nên chưa tải về được.").
pre: A recording with a completed transcript; Secretary, Chair and Member on the roster.

cases.d: Verify a Secret meeting keeps its audio and words inside.
steps: Mark the meeting Mật.
As the Chair, GET /api/recordings/<id>/download, /api/recordings/<id>/transcript.txt and /api/meetings/<id>/speech-clips.txt.
GET the list.
exp: Each export returns HTTP 403 with code "MSG356" ("Bản ghi và bản gỡ băng của cuộc họp Mật không được tải về.").
canDownload is false.
pre: A Secret meeting with a transcribed recording; signed in as its Chair.

cases.d: Verify the per-microphone transcript is saved without the sentences taken out.
steps: As the Member, send two sentences: "Tôi đồng ý." and "Ai tắt giúp cái điều hoà.".
As the Secretary, take the second out with PUT /api/speech-clips/<id>/exclusion { "excluded": true, "reason": "Other" }.
As the Member, GET /api/meetings/<id>/speech-clips.txt.
As the Secretary, GET the same file.
exp: Member: HTTP 403 "MSG355".
The Secretary's file has the line "Bản gỡ băng — ghi theo micro từng người", contains "Tôi đồng ý." with the speaker's name and does not contain the excluded sentence.
The audit log records one speech_clip.exported.
pre: An InProgress Online or Hybrid meeting (captured per microphone); Secretary and Member on the roster.

cases.d: Verify only the Secretary gets the machine's speaker guess and a correction is audited.
steps: Give SPEAKER_00 a suggested person (the Chair) with score 0.91.
As the Secretary, then as the Member, GET /api/recordings/<id>/transcript.
As the Secretary, PUT /api/transcript-segments/<first segment> with { "text": "Kính thưa các đồng chí, hôm nay" }.
exp: The Secretary sees suggestedUserId, suggestedName and suggestionScore.
The Member sees all three as null.
The audit log records one transcript.segment_edited.
pre: A recording with a completed transcript; Voice ID suggestion available.

cases.d: Verify everyone who reads the transcript hears a sentence through a signed link.
steps: As the Member, send half a second of 16 kHz mono PCM WAV.
As the Chair, GET /api/meetings/<id>/speech-clips and read peaks.
GET /api/speech-clips/<id>/playback and open the url without signing in.
Open the url with its signature changed, the bare /audio path, and the url with /speech-clips/ replaced by /recordings/.
As an outsider, the organizer, and without signing in, GET the playback; GET playback for an unknown id.
Open the url after 3 hours.
exp: The line has one waveform byte per 100 ms: 0, 0, 180, 180, 180.
The url starts with /api/speech-clips/<id>/audio?expires= and returns the same audio/wav bytes.
Every altered url returns HTTP 404.
Outsider, organizer and unknown id: HTTP 404; not signed in: HTTP 401.
The expired url returns HTTP 404.
pre: An InProgress Online or Hybrid meeting (captured per microphone); Chair and Member on the roster; an outsider and the organizer are not.

cases.d: Verify a sentence taken out of the record is heard only by the Chair and the Secretary.
steps: As the Chair, take a Member's sentence out (reason Other).
As the Member, GET the speech clips and the sentence's playback.
As the Chair, do the same.
exp: Taking it out returns HTTP 200 "MSG351".
Member: hasAudio is false; playback returns HTTP 404.
Chair: hasAudio is true; playback returns HTTP 200.
pre: An InProgress Online or Hybrid meeting (captured per microphone) with a stored sentence.

cases.d: Verify a database outage while signing a link says so.
steps: Stop PostgreSQL (or make reading sentences fail).
As the Member, GET /api/speech-clips/<id>/playback.
exp: HTTP 500 with code "MSG297" ("Không tải được danh sách bản ghi.").
pre: An InProgress Online or Hybrid meeting (captured per microphone) with a stored sentence.

cases.d: Verify a sentence the database could not store leaves no audio behind.
steps: Make saving fail (stop PostgreSQL during the save).
As the Member, send a sentence.
exp: HTTP 503 with code "MSG304" ("Không lưu được thay đổi bản gỡ băng. Vui lòng thử lại.").
No audio file is left in storage.
pre: An InProgress Online or Hybrid meeting (captured per microphone); speech worker running.

cases.d: Verify deleting a sentence, or its retention running out, erases its audio.
steps: As the Member, store two sentences.
DELETE /api/speech-clips/<first>.
Make the second 181 days old and run the retention sweep.
exp: Deleting returns HTTP 200 "MSG322" ("Đã xoá câu nói."); its audio file is erased, the other stays.
After the sweep, the expired sentence and its audio are gone.
pre: An InProgress Online or Hybrid meeting (captured per microphone); retention 180 days.

cases.d: Verify a quiet copy of a neighbour's sentence is marked for everyone and kept.
steps: As the Member, send a sentence that is a quieter copy (about 14 dB lower) of what the Chair said, 300 ms later on its clock; GET the list.
A second later, as the Chair, send the original sentence.
As the Member, GET the list with ?since=<readAt of the first read>, then the whole list.
exp: Before the Chair's sentence arrives the Member's line has leak null.
The ?since read returns both lines: the Member's line is marked leak with the Chair's clipId, speakerName and whole true; the Chair's line has leak null.
Both lines stay in the list: the copy is marked, not hidden.
pre: An InProgress Online or Hybrid meeting (captured per microphone); Chair and Member on the roster; speech worker running.

cases.d: Verify the Chair or a Secretary takes a sentence out of the record and puts it back.
steps: As the Member, GET the list (canExclude) and PUT /api/speech-clips/<id>/exclusion { "excluded": true, "reason": "Leak" }.
As the Chair, PUT with reason "Rò rỉ", then with "Leak" twice.
As the Chair and as the Member, GET the list.
As the Secretary, PUT { "excluded": false }.
PUT for an unknown id.
exp: Member: canExclude is false; HTTP 403 "MSG353" ("Chỉ Chủ tọa hoặc Thư ký được loại câu khỏi bản ghi.").
Wrong reason: HTTP 400 "MSG354" ("Lý do loại câu không hợp lệ."). Valid: HTTP 200 "MSG351" ("Đã loại câu khỏi bản ghi."); the second tap changes nothing.
The Chair sees the words, the reason and who took it out; the Member sees an excluded line with empty text and no name.
Putting back returns HTTP 200 "MSG352" ("Đã đưa câu trở lại bản ghi."); the audit log has speech_clip.excluded then speech_clip.restored.
Unknown id: HTTP 404.
pre: An InProgress Online or Hybrid meeting (captured per microphone) with a stored sentence; Chair, Secretary and Member on the roster.

cases.d: Verify a sentence kept on the device still arrives up to a week after the meeting.
steps: End the meeting one day ago.
As the Member, GET the list (canCapture), then send a sentence said 5 minutes before the end.
Send a sentence whose startedAt is after the meeting ended.
Move the end beyond the 7-day window and send again.
exp: canCapture is false, yet the late sentence returns HTTP 200 "MSG318" with its own startedAt.
A sentence dated after the end is saved as ending when the meeting ended.
Past 7 days: HTTP 409 "MSG320".
pre: An Ended Online meeting with the Member on its roster; speech worker running.

cases.d: Verify a sample recording is kept only under the newer notice and only its owner hears it.
steps: With consent to notice 1.0, POST /api/me/voice/samples and GET its /audio.
POST /api/me/voice/consent with the current noticeVersion.
POST another sample and GET /api/me/voice/samples/<id>/audio.
As another user, then without signing in, GET the same /audio.
exp: The old sample returns HTTP 201 "MSG307" with playable false; its audio returns HTTP 404.
Renewing returns HTTP 200 "MSG305" with the current noticeVersion; the existing sample stays and the same consent row is renewed (audited).
The new sample is playable; its audio returns HTTP 200 audio/webm with Cache-Control no-store; the stored copy is encrypted.
Another user: HTTP 404. Not signed in: HTTP 401.
pre: Signed in as thanhvien@trustcabinet.local, who agreed to the earlier notice 1.0; speech worker running.
